meta.title: Customer Service Job, Wuse 2, Abuja | Traction Outsourcing
meta.description: Customer Service job in Wuse 2, Abuja at ₦100,000/month. Full-time role with a health and wellness business. 2+ years' experience required. Apply online at Traction Outsourcing Limited.
meta.image_alt: Smiling woman in a yellow turtleneck wearing a headset beside the Traction Outsourcing logo and an Apply Now button, for the Customer Service job

hero.headline: Customer Service
hero.sub: We are hiring a Customer Service for a health and wellness business in Wuse 2, Abuja. Full-time · ₦100,000/month.

lists.heading: Job Description
items: Welcome and assist customers who walk into the store, and recommend suitable products.
Respond to customer enquiries and messages online (WhatsApp, social media and calls).
Record orders accurately and follow up so customers are satisfied.
Handle complaints politely and pass on issues that need a manager.

lists.heading: Requirements
items: At least 2 years' experience in customer service, sales or a similar role.
Good communication skills, in person and in writing.
Comfortable using a phone, WhatsApp and basic computer tools.
Able to commute to Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately.

sections.heading: Application Form
sections.sub: Please fill in every field. Your CV must be uploaded as a PDF file.
sections.notice: DO NOT APPLY MORE THAN ONCE. DOUBLE APPLICATIONS WILL BE DISQUALIFIED
sections.success_message: Thank you for your application. We will reach out to qualified candidates.
